accounting.interpretation: These fractions are not recall, independent human truth, precision calibration, semantic acceptance, or Gate A. Citation anchoring, semantic judgment, and raw citation integrity are separate. Reviewer kind is self-attested.

filter_definitions.all_schema_valid: Every retrospectively selected schema-valid generated claim origin, regardless of evidence-integrity result.
filter_definitions.raw_integrity: A schema-valid raw claim passes when verify_candidate returns REVIEW for its original evidence offsets.
filter_definitions.anchored_integrity: A schema-valid claim passes when unique exact-quote anchoring is applied and verify_candidate returns REVIEW.

limitations: Filters are applied retrospectively only to schema-valid origins selected for review.
REVIEW means evidence-integrity checks passed; it is not semantic acceptance or truth.
Review labels are self-attested; reviewer identity and independence are unverified.
Candidate-denominator coverage is not whole-output success, recall, or precision.
No calibration or precision guarantee, Gate A result, prospective test, runtime acceptance policy, or model superiority follows from this report.
Unique quote anchoring changes offsets only and does not establish entailment.
